title: Implement and recover a leased durable queue across two restarts
prompt: Complete the durable queue contract across three controlled sessions and demonstrate recovery of persisted state after each server restart.

phases.prompt: Implement queue creation, enqueue, and lease behavior from SPEC.md, including persistence and tests. Leave acknowledgement, retry, and CLI scenario work for later sessions.
Recover the same queue task after restart. Add ack, retry, expired-lease recovery, and crash-safe persistence. Run tests, but leave the seeded end-to-end scenario for the final session.
Resume after the second restart. Finish the CLI and execute scenario.json against queue-state.json. Verify final queue state and the deterministic result artifact before completing.
